name: Verified revenue
business_question: How much value was completed and verified during the selected period?
decision: Monitor performance and investigate meaningful declines or increases.
formula: SUM(amount) over one validated canonical row per session where session_status = 'Verified'
numerator: Sum of amount for eligible verified sessions
null_policy: Required fields must be non-null; invalid sessions are quarantined and counted.
minimum_sample_rule: At least 1 eligible verified session; suppress comparisons when the baseline is absent.
